extraction.policy_summary: BFL Group has a dedicated internal 'Policy for person with Specially abled' (listed in its principle-wise policy register, marked as an internal document). It is also covered by the Code of Ethics and Personal Conduct (CoEPC), an Equal Employment Opportunity and Non-Discrimination policy adopted in accordance with the RPwD Act 2016, and the Employee Charter - Human Rights Statement, all prohibiting disability-based discrimination in employment. Policies are available at a public web link.
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: FY2025-26: 77 total differently abled employees (25 permanent, 52 other-than-permanent) -- 68 male (88.31%) and 9 female (11.69%). Noted as based on disability certificates voluntarily disclosed by employees. Not applicable for workers (BFL is a financial services business with no worker category).
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: Some of BFL's offices and branches are designed to ensure accessibility for differently abled employees; 320+ branches and offices are equipped with wheelchairs; 3,300+ branches are equipped with magnifying glasses; some corporate and branch offices have ramps for easy movement of differently abled people.
extraction.recruitment_details: Among BFL's stated FY2027 commitments/goals: 'To hire 200+ Specially abled employees, to promote an inclusive and diverse workforce.' This is a forward-looking numeric target for a future financial year; no attainment against it is reported in this filing (which covers FY2025-26).
extraction.culture_practices_details: Persons with disability are named as an identified stakeholder group (alongside women and other genders) with a dedicated ongoing engagement channel: 'HR connect forums' held on an ongoing/need-based basis, aimed at creating 'a thriving, safe and inclusive workplace.' No further detail on forum frequency, participation, or specific outcomes for PwD employees is given.
